meta.title: Pullwise — which pack to open in Pokémon TCG Pocket
meta.description: Build your deck, mark the cards you are missing, and find out which pack to open and how many you will need.

decks.title: Decks
decks.missing: {count, plural, one {# card missing} other {# cards missing}}
decks.emptyBody: Pullwise never asks you to log your whole collection. Build a deck, mark the few cards you are missing, and it tells you which pack to open to finish it.
decks.emptyAction: Paste a list you already have

editor.empty: Add cards to get started. They are assumed to be yours — only mark the ones you are missing.
editor.addToDeck: Add {name} to the deck ({count} in deck)
editor.searchPlaceholder: Search a card, or paste a list…
editor.emptySlots: {count, plural, one {# slot left} other {# slots left}}
editor.lineGapBody: An evolution cannot be played without its line.
editor.notFoundTitle: This deck is not on this device.
editor.notFoundBody: Pullwise keeps your decks in your own browser, never on a server, so a deck link only opens where the deck was built.
editor.getCodeHint: Scan it in-game to import this deck. Cards you have not marked show up there as a shopping list — you do not need to own them first.
editor.getCodeErrorNoEnergy: Pick an energy type to include it in the code — none is set, and this deck’s Pokémon do not suggest one either.
editor.getCodeErrorEmpty: Add a card to this deck before generating a code.
editor.exportListHint: Paste this into Limitless or anywhere else that reads a decklist. Cards you have not marked are included the same as any other.
editor.exportListErrorEmpty: Add a card to this deck before exporting a list.

card.ownershipTitle: You have {have} of the {needed} copies this deck needs. Click to change.
card.removeCopy: Remove one copy of {name} from the deck
card.addCopy: Add one copy of {name} to the deck
card.copySlot: {name}: copy {index} of {total}. {owned, select, yes {You have it} other {Missing}}. Click to change.
card.copyLights: {name}: {have} of {needed} copies owned. Press to change.

ranking.nothingMissing: You are not missing anything for this deck.
ranking.strategy: Always opening the best pack for whatever is missing at the time.
ranking.censored: One card is so rare the calculation was cut short: treat this as a floor.
ranking.estimatedTitle: This set has not published its real odds yet: the previous equivalent set's are used.
ranking.explainer: The percentage is the chance that a pack contains at least one card you are missing.
ranking.notFromPacksBody: {list} — these are promo or mission cards, earned through in-game events.
ranking.coachAllHere: {count, plural, one {You are missing # card and it comes from here} other {You are missing # cards and they all come from here}}.
ranking.coachMostlyHere: You are missing {count} cards; {here, plural, one {# of them comes} other {# of them come}} from here.
ranking.coachOnlyOne: It is the only pack that has what you are missing.
ranking.relativeToWinner: How this pack compares to the recommended one above.
ranking.recommendationHint: The pack most likely to give you something you need right now, recalculated as your deck changes. Always opening the top choice is the strategy that finishes a deck in the fewest packs, on average — not a guess.

advisor.title: Which pack to open
advisor.emptyBody: Build a deck and mark the cards you are missing. With that, Pullwise can tell you which pack is worth opening and how many you will need.

browser.title: Cards
browser.marked: You marked {known, number} of {total, number}. The rest stays unopined, and that is fine.
browser.unmarked: Browse the catalogue. You do not need to mark anything: it fills in as you build decks.

cardPage.metaNotFound: Not available from packs: it is a promo or mission card.

cardPage.ctaBody: Want it for a specific deck? Pullwise cross-checks the whole deck against what you already own and tells you which pack to open first.

home.headline: Which pack finishes your deck?
home.body: Build the deck you want, mark the few cards you are missing, and Pullwise works out which pack to open and how many it will take. No account, and nobody has to log 3,879 cards.
